title: Which file does make read?
objective: Give GNUmakefile and Makefile different default goals and confirm which one a bare make picks up.
hint: make looks for GNUmakefile first, then makefile, then Makefile. Use make -f <name> to read a specific one.

steps.description: the GNUmakefile can still be named explicitly

lesson.goal: 知道 make 如何选择 Makefile。
lesson.prediction: 目录中同时存在 GNUmakefile 和 Makefile 时，裸 make 读取谁？
hints: GNU Make 有固定的文件名搜索顺序。
make -f 文件名可以跳过默认搜索。
让两个文件输出不同文本，再用三条检查命令比较。
lesson.explanation: GNUmakefile 的优先级高于 makefile 和 Makefile；-f 可以显式指定。
